tests_written.rationale: Contract tests cover the canonical template, explicit script invocation, artifact graph, and retired-path exclusion.

tests_passed.rationale: The focused artifact and package suite exited zero and is repeated by the release gate.

persistence_real.rationale: The packaged initializer copies the real installed template into a temporary filesystem project and reads it back.

feature_flags_audit.rationale: This task adds no runtime feature flag or default-off product path.

vertical_slice.rationale: The test packs npm, installs from the tarball, installs the Claude plugin, and initializes canonical project files.

spec_trace.rationale: The task trace anchor exists and names every canonical artifact lifecycle.

limitations: Authenticated cross-provider behavior is outside this local artifact task.
